## CORE_VIEW_WGSL
const CORE_VIEW_WGSL = "\nstruct CoreView {\n  viewProj: mat4x4f,\n  position: vec4f,\n  planes: array<vec4f, 6>,\n  index: u32,\n  _a: u32,\n  _b: u32,\n  _c: u32,\n  origin: vec4f,\n  _pad: array<vec4f, 3>,\n};\n";

## CULL_WGSL
const CULL_WGSL = "\nstruct CoreView {\n  viewProj: mat4x4f,\n  position: vec4f,\n  planes: array<vec4f, 6>,\n  index: u32,\n  _a: u32,\n  _b: u32,\n  _c: u32,\n  origin: vec4f,\n  _pad: array<vec4f, 3>,\n};\n\nstruct CullParams { count: u32, capacity: u32, views: u32, firstInstance: u32 };\nstruct Slot { sphere: vec4f, draw: vec4u, inst: vec4u };\n@group(0) @binding(0) var<uniform> views: array<CoreView, 8>;\n@group(0) @binding(1) var<uniform> params: CullParams;\n@group(0) @binding(2) var<storage, read> slots: array<Slot>;\n@group(0) @binding(3) var<storage, read_write> args: array<u32>;\n\n@compute @workgroup_size(64) fn cs_cull(@builtin(global_invocation_id) id: vec3u) {\n  let i = id.x;\n  let v = id.y;\n  if (i >= params.count || v >= params.views) { return; }\n  let s = slots[i];\n  var visible = (s.inst.y & 3u) == 1u;\n  for (var k = 0u; k < 6u; k++) {\n    let p = views[v].planes[k];\n    if (dot(p.xyz, s.sphere.xyz) + p.w < -s.sphere.w) { visible = false; }\n  }\n  let o = (v * params.capacity + i) * 5u;\n  args[o] = s.draw.x;\n  args[o + 1u] = select(0u, s.draw.w, visible);\n  args[o + 2u] = s.draw.y;\n  args[o + 3u] = s.draw.z;\n  args[o + 4u] = select(0u, s.inst.x, params.firstInstance != 0u);\n}\n";

class Camera {

     viewLayout: GPUBindGroupLayout;

     viewBuffer: GPUBuffer;
     readonly viewData: Float32Array;
    restores: number;

    createArena(desc: ArenaDesc): Arena;
    restore(device: GPUDevice): void;

    destroy(): void;
}

## Renderer
class Renderer implements FrameSink {
    readonly device: GPUDevice;
    readonly context: GPUCanvasContext;
    readonly format: GPUTextureFormat;
    readonly sceneFormats: readonly GPUTextureFormat[];
    readonly logicalWidth: number;
    readonly logicalHeight: number;
    camera: Camera;
    readonly samplers: Record<SamplerKind, GPUSampler>;
    readonly caps: RendererCaps;
    readonly globalsLayout: GPUBindGroupLayout;
    globalsBindGroup: GPUBindGroup;
    readonly quad: Mesh;
    readonly defaultSprite: Material;
    readonly stats: RenderStats;
    lodHysteresis: number;
    readonly timing: FrameTiming;
    readonly gpuTimer: GpuTimer | null;
    timingEvery: number;
    post: PostProcessor | null;
    width: number;
    height: number;
    outputWidth: number;
    outputHeight: number;
    readonly target: SceneTarget;
    core: RenderCore | null;
    constructor(gpu: RendererGpu, opts?: RendererOptions);
    get sceneColor(): Texture;
    get sceneEmissive(): Texture;
    resize(width: number, height: number): void;
    setResolution(opts: ResolutionOptions): void;
    get resolutionOptions(): Readonly<Required<ResolutionOptions>>;
    get resolutionScale(): number;
    onGpuTime(fn: (gpuMs: number) => void): () => void;
    onResize(fn: (width: number, height: number) => void): () => void;
    sceneTargets(blend?: GPUBlendState, aux?: number): GPUColorTargetState[];
    createMaterial(desc: MaterialDesc): Material;
    createSpriteMaterial(opts: SpriteMaterialOptions): Material;
    createMesh(desc: MeshDesc): Mesh;
    createMeshLod(desc: MeshLodDesc): MeshLodChain;
    createTexture(desc: TextureDesc): Texture;
    createSceneTarget(desc: SceneTargetDesc): SceneTarget;
    createRenderTarget(desc: TextureDesc): Texture;
    createFullscreenPass(desc: FullscreenPassDesc): FullscreenPass;
    textureFromSource(source: TextureSource, label?: string | TextureFromSourceOptions, opts?: TextureFromSourceOptions): Texture;
    textureFromPixels(desc: {
        width: number;
        height: number;
        data: PixelData;
        format?: GPUTextureFormat;
        label?: string;
        usage?: GPUTextureUsageFlags;
    }): Texture;
    writePixels(tex: Texture, data: PixelData): void;
    createPingPong(desc: TextureDesc): PingPong;
    textureFromShader(opts: {
        width: number;
        height: number;
        wgsl: string;
        label?: string;
        format?: GPUTextureFormat;
        uniforms?: Float32Array<ArrayBuffer>;
    }): Texture;
    setJitter(fn: JitterFn | null): void;
    get jitter(): JitterFn | null;
    lodLevelOf(batch: object, index: number, camera?: Camera): number;
    beginFrame(time: number, dt: number): Frame;
    render(frame: Frame, camera: Camera, target?: SceneTarget): void;
    resolve(target: SceneTarget, out: GPUTextureView, viewport?: SceneTargetViewport): void;
    endFrame(opts?: {
        present?: boolean;
    }): void;
    destroy(): void;
    pushInstance(material: Material, mesh: Mesh, tr: Transform | null, p: DrawParams | InstanceParams, bounds: MeshBounds | null, lod?: MeshLod | null): void;
    pushBatch(material: Material, mesh: Mesh, batch: InstanceBatch, bounds: MeshBounds | null, list: InstanceList | null, lod?: MeshLod | null): void;
    createInstanceList(mesh: Mesh | MeshLod, material: Material, capacity: number, opts?: InstanceListOptions): InstanceList;
    pushDrawable(d: Drawable, order: number, layers: number): void;
    pushPrePass(fn: (encoder: GPUCommandEncoder) => void): void;
}

    readonly wgslNormal: string;
    readonly positionOffset?: number;
    readonly skinned?: boolean;
    readonly wgslTangent?: string;
    readonly wgslUv1?: string;
    readonly wgslPreviousPosition?: string;
}

## ViewInfo  (type-only)
interface ViewInfo {
    camera: Camera;
    target: SceneTarget;
    depthCopy: GPUTexture;
    depthView: GPUTextureView;
    viewport: {
        x: number;
        y: number;
        width: number;
        height: number;
    };
}

## WGSL_FULLSCREEN_PRELUDE
const WGSL_FULLSCREEN_PRELUDE = "\n\nfn engine_hash21(p: vec2f) -> f32 {\n  var p3 = fract(vec3f(p.x, p.y, p.x) * 0.1031);\n  p3 += dot(p3, p3.yzx + 33.33);\n  return fract((p3.x + p3.y) * p3.z);\n}\nfn engine_hash22(p: vec2f) -> vec2f {\n  var p3 = fract(vec3f(p.x, p.y, p.x) * vec3f(0.1031, 0.1030, 0.0973));\n  p3 += dot(p3, p3.yzx + 33.33);\n  return fract((p3.xx + p3.yz) * p3.zy);\n}\nfn engine_noise(p: vec2f) -> f32 {\n  let i = floor(p);\n  let f = fract(p);\n  let u = f * f * (3.0 - 2.0 * f);\n  let a = engine_hash21(i);\n  let b = engine_hash21(i + vec2f(1.0, 0.0));\n  let c = engine_hash21(i + vec2f(0.0, 1.0));\n  let d = engine_hash21(i + vec2f(1.0, 1.0));\n  return mix(mix(a, b, u.x), mix(c, d, u.x), u.y);\n}\nfn engine_fbm(p: vec2f, octaves: i32) -> f32 {\n  var v = 0.0;\n  var amp = 0.5;\n  var q = p;\n  for (var i = 0; i < octaves; i++) {\n    v += amp * engine_noise(q);\n    q = q * 2.03 + vec2f(17.1, 9.2);\n    amp *= 0.5;\n  }\n  return v;\n}\nfn engine_luma(c: vec3f) -> f32 {\n  return dot(c, vec3f(0.2126, 0.7152, 0.0722));\n}\n\nstruct FullscreenIn {\n  @builtin(position) pos: vec4f,\n  @location(0) uv: vec2f,\n};\n@vertex fn vs_fullscreen(@builtin(vertex_index) i: u32) -> FullscreenIn {\n  let p = vec2f(f32((i << 1u) & 2u), f32(i & 2u));\n  var o: FullscreenIn;\n  o.pos = vec4f(p * 2.0 - 1.0, 0.0, 1.0);\n  o.uv = vec2f(p.x, 1.0 - p.y);\n  return o;\n}\n";

## WGSL_GLOBALS
const WGSL_GLOBALS = "\nstruct EngineGlobals {\n  logicalSize: vec2f,\n  targetSize: vec2f,\n  time: f32,\n  dt: f32,\n  _pad: vec2f,\n};\n@group(0) @binding(0) var<uniform> globals: EngineGlobals;\nstruct EngineCamera {\n  view: mat4x4f,\n  proj: mat4x4f,\n  view_proj: mat4x4f,\n  camera_pos: vec4f,\n  viewport: vec4f,\n  view_index: u32,\n  _pad0: u32, _pad1: u32, _pad2: u32,\n  inv_view_proj: mat4x4f,\n  prev_view_proj: mat4x4f,\n  prev_view: mat4x4f,\n  jitter: vec4f,\n};\n@group(0) @binding(1) var<uniform> camera: EngineCamera;\n";

## WGSL_NOISE
const WGSL_NOISE = "\nfn engine_hash21(p: vec2f) -> f32 {\n  var p3 = fract(vec3f(p.x, p.y, p.x) * 0.1031);\n  p3 += dot(p3, p3.yzx + 33.33);\n  return fract((p3.x + p3.y) * p3.z);\n}\nfn engine_hash22(p: vec2f) -> vec2f {\n  var p3 = fract(vec3f(p.x, p.y, p.x) * vec3f(0.1031, 0.1030, 0.0973));\n  p3 += dot(p3, p3.yzx + 33.33);\n  return fract((p3.xx + p3.yz) * p3.zy);\n}\nfn engine_noise(p: vec2f) -> f32 {\n  let i = floor(p);\n  let f = fract(p);\n  let u = f * f * (3.0 - 2.0 * f);\n  let a = engine_hash21(i);\n  let b = engine_hash21(i + vec2f(1.0, 0.0));\n  let c = engine_hash21(i + vec2f(0.0, 1.0));\n  let d = engine_hash21(i + vec2f(1.0, 1.0));\n  return mix(mix(a, b, u.x), mix(c, d, u.x), u.y);\n}\nfn engine_fbm(p: vec2f, octaves: i32) -> f32 {\n  var v = 0.0;\n  var amp = 0.5;\n  var q = p;\n  for (var i = 0; i < octaves; i++) {\n    v += amp * engine_noise(q);\n    q = q * 2.03 + vec2f(17.1, 9.2);\n    amp *= 0.5;\n  }\n  return v;\n}\nfn engine_luma(c: vec3f) -> f32 {\n  return dot(c, vec3f(0.2126, 0.7152, 0.0722));\n}\n";

## WGSL_SKIN
const WGSL_SKIN = "struct EngineSkinPalette {\n  joints: u32,\n  instances: u32,\n  history: u32,\n  _pad1: u32,\n  rows: array<vec4f>,\n};\n@group(1) @binding(16) var<storage, read> engine_skin_palette: EngineSkinPalette;\nstruct EngineSkinned {\n  position: vec3f,\n  normal: vec3f,\n};\nfn engine_skin(v: VertexIn, position: vec3f, normal: vec3f) -> EngineSkinned {\n  let base = u32(v.params.w) * engine_skin_palette.joints * 3u;\n  let p = vec4f(position, 1.0);\n  var skinned: EngineSkinned;\n  skinned.position = vec3f(0.0);\n  skinned.normal = vec3f(0.0);\n  for (var k = 0u; k < 4u; k++) {\n    let w = v.weights[k];\n    if (w == 0.0) { continue; }\n    let r = base + v.joints[k] * 3u;\n    let r0 = engine_skin_palette.rows[r];\n    let r1 = engine_skin_palette.rows[r + 1u];\n    let r2 = engine_skin_palette.rows[r + 2u];\n    skinned.position += w * vec3f(dot(r0, p), dot(r1, p), dot(r2, p));\n    skinned.normal += w * vec3f(dot(r0.xyz, normal), dot(r1.xyz, normal), dot(r2.xyz, normal));\n  }\n  return skinned;\n}\n// The previous frame's skinned position from the palette's history block (SkinPalette\n// with history), w = 1; w = 0 when the palette keeps none (velocity reads zero).\nfn engine_skin_previous(v: VertexIn, position: vec3f) -> vec4f {\n  if (engine_skin_palette.history == 0u) { return vec4f(0.0); }\n  let base = (engine_skin_palette.instances + u32(v.params.w)) * engine_skin_palette.joints * 3u;\n  let p = vec4f(position, 1.0);\n  var out = vec3f(0.0);\n  for (var k = 0u; k < 4u; k++) {\n    let w = v.weights[k];\n    if (w == 0.0) { continue; }\n    let r = base + v.joints[k] * 3u;\n    out += w * vec3f(dot(engine_skin_palette.rows[r], p), dot(engine_skin_palette.rows[r + 1u], p), dot(engine_skin_palette.rows[r + 2u], p));\n  }\n  return vec4f(out, 1.0);\n}";
